en: The Dyad on Mental Conjoined, Originated, and Co-existent Phenomena (Cittasaṁsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka)

Dependent on a state that is not conjoined with mind, not produced by mind, and does not follow upon mind, there arises a state that is not conjoined with mind, not produced by mind, and does not follow upon mind, by way of root condition. … (Abbreviated. Nine under root;
… pe … five under prenascence and repetition; … pe … nine under non-disappearance. (Full detail in all cases.)
